title: Strict coordinate-induced maps of the prescribed Godement models
statement: For a scheme $X$, let $G_X$ and $a_X:\mathcal O_X[0]\to J_X$ be the prescribed Godement cosimplicial model and its extended alternating-coface augmentation [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-godement-construction]. Let $e_X:J_X^0\simeq G_X^0$ be its extension identification [lem-sc-module-cup-godement-cosimplicial-input]. There is a choice, for every morphism $f:Y\to X$ and module morphism $q:\mathcal O_X\to f_*\mathcal O_Y$, of a cosimplicial module morphism $g(f,q):G_X\to f_*G_Y$ satisfying the following equations in every simplex degree $n$. For the identity and the canonical $q:\mathcal O_X\to (\mathrm{id}_X)_*\mathcal O_X$, $g(\mathrm{id},q)^n$ is the canonical inverse pushforward-identity identification on $G_X^n$. For $k:Z\to Y$ and $r:\mathcal O_Y\to k_*\mathcal O_Z$, writing $c:f_*k_*\simeq(f\circ k)_*$ for the pushforward-composition identification, one has $g(f\circ k,c\,f_*r\,q)^n=c\,f_*g(k,r)^n\,g(f,q)^n$. Finally $g(f,q)^0e_Xa_X^0=f_*(e_Ya_Y^0)q$. The family includes empty schemes and requires no quasi-isomorphism or flasqueness hypotheses. The same family admits extended cochain maps $l(f,q):J_X\to f_*J_Y$ whose component in a nonnegative degree $m$ is $f_*((e_Y^m)^{-1})g(f,q)^m e_X^m$, where $e_X^m:J_X^m\simeq G_X^m$ are the corresponding extension identifications. Their actual chain-augmentation equation is $l(f,q)^0a_X^0=f_*(a_Y^0)q$. In every integer degree they satisfy the same pushforward-identity and pushforward-composition equations as $g$, with $G_X^n$ replaced by $J_X^n$.

proof.text: For a scheme map f and coefficient map q, use the existing coordinate-induced stalk map and product lift from the Godement f-map construction. Represent a stalk section by a germ; its image germ is the coefficient image on the inverse-image open. This proves identity and composition on stalks. Project to each skyscraper coordinate to get identity and composition for the product lift, then induct on the number of iterates.

Use modelMap for the prescribed models, whose components are the iterated maps conjugated by the specified term equalities. Its existing proof gives naturality for cofaces and codegeneracies. The inverse equality transports cancel for compositions; naturality of pushforwardComp identifies the remaining composite with the iterated composite from step 1. Naturality of pushforwardId gives the identity equation. The existing modelMap_augmentation gives the actual degree-zero germ equation. Package the maps for all schemes, morphisms and coefficient maps simultaneously.

Apply the existing crossMap construction to the cosimplicial maps. Its natural-degree formula is the source extension identification, followed by g, followed by the pushed-forward inverse target identification. For identities use naturality of pushforwardId and cancel these two identifications. For compositions cancel the middle source/target identifications and use naturality of pushforwardComp together with the cosimplicial composition equation. In negative degrees the source term is zero, so both equations are automatic. Postcompose the cosimplicial augmentation square with the pushed-forward inverse target identification; functoriality and the inverse equations give the actual cochain-augmentation equation.

theorem ringComplex_godement_model_maps :
    ∃ g : ∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X),
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
          (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) →
        (ringComplexGodementModel X ⟶ ringComplexGodementModel Y ⋙ pushforward f),
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory),
        (g X X (𝟙 X) ((pushforwardId X).inv.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).app n =
            (pushforwardId X).inv.app ((ringComplexGodementModel X).obj n)) ∧
      (∀ (X Y Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X) (k : Z ⟶ Y)
        (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
          (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))
        (r : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶
          (pushforward k).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))
        (n : SimplexCategory),
        (g X Z (k ≫ f) (q ≫ (pushforward f).map r ≫
          (pushforwardComp k f).hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))).app n =
            (g X Y f q).app n ≫ (pushforward f).map ((g Y Z k r).app n) ≫
              (pushforwardComp k f).hom.app ((ringComplexGodementModel Z).obj n)) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
          (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)),
        (ringComplexGodementUnit X).f 0 ≫
            (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X (ringComplexGodementModel X)).hom ≫
            (g X Y f q).app ⦋0⦌ =
          q ≫ (pushforward f).map ((ringComplexGodementUnit Y).f 0 ≫
            (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso Y (ringComplexGodementModel Y)).hom)) ∧
      ∃ l : ∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X),
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
            (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) →
          (ringComplexGodementResolution X ⟶
            ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (ringComplexGodementResolution Y)),
        (∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X)
          (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
            (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) (n : ℕ),
          (l X Y f q).f (n : ℤ) =
            (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj
              (ringComplexGodementModel X)).extendXIso
                ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).hom ≫ (g X Y f q).app ⦋n⦌ ≫
            (pushforward f).map
              ((((alternatingCofaceMapComplex Y.Modules).obj
                (ringComplexGodementModel Y)).extendXIso
                  ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).inv)) ∧
        (∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X)
          (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
            (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)),
          (ringComplexGodementUnit X).f 0 ≫ (l X Y f q).f 0 =
            q ≫ (pushforward f).map ((ringComplexGodementUnit Y).f 0)) ∧
        (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℤ),
          (l X X (𝟙 X) ((pushforwardId X).inv.app
            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).f n =
              (pushforwardId X).inv.app ((ringComplexGodementResolution X).X n)) ∧
        (∀ (X Y Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X) (k : Z ⟶ Y)
          (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
            (pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))
          (r : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶
            (pushforward k).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) (n : ℤ),
          (l X Z (k ≫ f) (q ≫ (pushforward f).map r ≫
            (pushforwardComp k f).hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))).f n =
              (l X Y f q).f n ≫ (pushforward f).map ((l Y Z k r).f n) ≫
                (pushforwardComp k f).hom.app ((ringComplexGodementResolution Z).X n))

Reuse its generic crossMap construction for alternating coface complexes and extension by zero; its cup-pairing unit remains untouched.
